# Rule

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Rule>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The abstract base of a deontic rule in a rights statement — it binds a regulated [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) to an optional target asset and assignee. Specialised by [`gmeow:Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md), [`gmeow:Prohibition`](gmeow-Prohibition.md) and [`gmeow:Duty`](gmeow-Duty.md) (the ODRL rule trio).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
